neighbours.label: In protein biochemistry prose, the position just before a peptide, protein, amine or amino-acid term is named (small| peptides, numerous other| peptide hormones, sulphur-containing| amino acid, pol|ypeptide, mono|amine): the unit anticipates protein-chemistry vocabulary
fire: Insulin is a small protein made of two chains joined by disulphide bonds.
Trypsin cuts the polypeptide after every lysine or arginine residue.
Serotonin is a monoamine neurotransmitter derived from tryptophan.
Collagen is the most abundant structural protein in mammals.
Methionine is an essential amino acid that starts most polypeptide chains.
Oxytocin and vasopressin are short peptide hormones released by the pituitary.
The kinase phosphorylates a serine residue near the carboxyl terminus.
Ubiquitin is a small regulatory protein that tags other proteins for degradation.
quiet: Quartz is a hard crystalline mineral made of silicon and oxygen.
The saw cuts the plank after every third mark on the rail.
The monorail is a single-track railway raised above the street.
Basalt is the most abundant volcanic rock on the ocean floor.
Helium is a noble gas that starts the second column of the periodic table.
Mercury and Venus are small rocky planets close to the sun.
The gardener prunes the branches near the top of the hedge.
A polygon is a closed figure made of straight line segments.

predictions: Sentences about proteins, peptides, amino acids and monoamines peak at 0.3-1.1 on the word before the term (small, structural, essential, short, regulatory, pol-, mono-). Mineral, geological, astronomical and everyday twins, including whole-token polygon and the split monorail, stay under 0.2.
notes: Probe: 'Enkephalins are small peptides' 1.128 (' small'), 'numerous other peptide hormones' 0.893 (' other'), 'sulphur-containing amino acid' 0.566 ('-containing'), 'polypeptide chain' 0.393 (' pol'), 'monoamine transporters' 0.331 ('amine'); 'polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons' 0.197 (' aromatic'), monorail 0.003, dipole 0.008, 'numerous other projects' 0.000.
